intakeMetadata.ts:42-54 parses and validates public example URL strings only. runtimeCompatibility.ts:286 populates runtime values from publicRuntimeValues(runtimeValues), not .env.example bytes. Broadened example host acceptance does not itself fetch a destination or grant it to runtime.

nonReportableObservations.description: Decoded attribute values permit TAB/LF/CR, while the URL scheme deny check matches raw text. An anchor href java	script:... is not caught by the javascript-scheme expression and remains in serialized preview HTML. Browser URL parsing strips internal ASCII tabs/newlines from a scheme.
nonReportableObservations.brokenControl: Raw attribute regex lacks browser-equivalent ASCII whitespace normalization/rejection
nonReportableObservations.sink: Serialized anchor navigation inside the application's preview document
nonReportableObservations.counterevidence: The attacker already controls the selected source module and executes arbitrary application JavaScript in the same preview authority. Blob policy allows inline application script but denies external resources/connects; HTTP runs within the existing isolated runner. No host, cross-tenant, canonical-source or greater network authority was established. This violates finite HTML acceptance rather than establishing a distinct security impact.
nonReportableObservations.validation: Not executed by discovery worker. Parent acknowledged the observation and plans a focused control/test follow-up after discovery; no imported application, VM or external URL was executed.

limitations: Static review only; parent owns candidate validation and final reportability.
CSS compiler internals and server resource-fetch/runtime-value authority are assigned to other workers; this review covered admission call sites.
